text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian deputy foreign minister arrives in Baghdad
- Energy committee at the National Assembly discusses prospects of future investments in oil and gas in Iraq
- Informatioon minister calls for the immediate withdrawal of Iranian troops from northern Iraq
- Iraqi workers to elect their trade union leaders tomorrow
- Transport ministry gears up for the ferrying of humanitarian supplies once Iraq's oil deal with the United Nations goes into effect
- Ministry of industry and minerals urges citizens to rationalise use of electricity
